note: The viewer's About words, written once: the page's About panel and first-visit line (src/ui/about.js), and the site's title, description, text without script, structured data and llms.txt (tools/stage_site.mjs) all read them. The page carries them in its scene as `about` (tools/lib/build_page.mjs), and the site's staging reads them from the staged page. Every sentence names the place it was taken from (`from`); none says more of Cells than that place does. What names anyone is `credit` alone (its words, and the organisation the structured data names as the source code's author and the site's publisher); a contact and further links are added here alone (`contact`, `links`), and every reader of this file shows them where they are given.

lead.text: Cells is a physics simulator for biology. It builds cells and tissues from explicit physical laws, from electrodiffusion, chemistry and transport to mechanics and molecular assembly, with energy, charge and matter accounted for at every step.
lead.from: the repository's README.md, its opening paragraph, the first two sentences

lead.text: This page is a 3D map of it: the parts and laws of its engine, the species, proteins and machines it draws, and replays of its experiments' runs.
Capabilities vary by model, and whole-cell integration is ongoing. No single run uses every part drawn here.

reading.text: Each part carries the level the project's record gives it, and no level the record does not state; its panel names the source and, where the record gives one, the date.
reading.from: the viewer's README, "Rules the map keeps" (it states no status the record does not state; every status has a source and, where the record gives one, a date), and the Experiments landing's words that each card shows its own level from the Engine map (data/replays/cards.source.json)

reading.text: Shapes are schematic unless a part's panel says otherwise. Clear glass shapes and grey outlines are scenery.
reading.from: the Protein atlas's legend ("Shapes are schematic", src/lenses/proteins.js) and the Scope view's legend ("Clear glass shapes and grey outlines are scenery", src/ui/viewer.js)
